title: Knights of Cydonia
headline: Bellamy's dad played on the hit behind 'Knights of Cydonia'
caption:
The best thing in Muse's Knights of Cydonia is the oldest thing in it, and it goes back to a record Matt Bellamy's dad played on.

The guitar sound was inspired by 'Telstar', the Tornados' 1962 number one, with George Bellamy on rhythm guitar. On the record that guitar plays the vocal melody for the first two minutes and three seconds, before the first verse, while the bass gallops underneath. If I could keep only one part of the song, it would be that stretch. Taken as a whole, the song also bears a striking resemblance to George's own composition, 'Ridin' the Wind'.

It came out as a single 20 years ago today.

comment: About the song, the title refers to the Cydonia region of Mars, which got famous for a rock formation that seemed to look like a human face.
